comparison.objective: Fit and hand-tighten an oxygen regulator on a pin-index cylinder valve, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a yoke, engage two indexing pins and a washer face, then tighten a T-handle screw while controlling a bulky regulator.
comparison.success_condition: Regulator seated within alignment tolerances, tightened to at least 0.75 N·m, stable and released without drop/tip hazards.
comparison.reason: This is keyed assembly and fastening; it does not adjust a parameter based on repeated dynamic response.
